description: Save discrete facts, preferences and decisions to memory as individually searchable atoms instead of one wall of text. Two-pass, no API key needed. PASS 1 — call with `text`: returns the text with the extraction rubric. PASS 2 — call with `facts: [...]`: stores each fact separately, deduped. YOU decide what the facts are; this tool stores them. Best for chat logs, research notes, meeting summaries.

facts.description: PASS 2. The atomic facts you extracted. Each is stored as its own searchable memory. Supplying this skips pass 1 entirely.

source.description: Optional label for where this came from (e.g. 'telegram', 'research', 'meeting')

text.description: PASS 1. Unstructured content to pull facts out of - notes, research, chat logs.

name: memory_extract
